result.question: In his letter to Felix the governor, what did the chief captain say the accusation against Paul involved?

readings.support: the accusation involved questions about their own law

assessments.reason: Verse 23:29 explicitly says “the accusation involved questions about their own law,” which is the same as questions about Jewish law.

result.reason: Acts 23:29 states the accusation involved questions about their own (Jewish) law.
